clue.text: "Götterdämmerung" is heaven-sent

definitions.meaning: Wagner's opera title is German for 'twilight of the gods', the gods' finish, read here as two words
something heaven-sent is a providential blessing arriving just when needed

explanation.surface: A music critic declares Wagner's great opera a gift from above.
explanation.walkthrough: The opera title means the twilight, or end, of the gods; split the answer as GODS END to see it. The second definition is adjectival in sense but the noun is a heaven-sent thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A stroke of providential luck feels sent from heaven, and the gods' finale is the Wagnerian twilight.

clue.text: Go on to evade capture!

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of disbelief, like 'you don't say!'

explanation.surface: A shout urging a fugitive to make a run for it.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a cry of incredulity and the verb for escaping arrest.

clue.text: Conscript takes vessel into Scottish river

indicators.note: into says the vessel's letters go inside the river's name

parts.note: the Dee flows through Aberdeenshire to the sea at Aberdeen
a raft is a simple floating craft

explanation.surface: A drafted soldier ferries a boat into a Highland river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' is just a link word; the container signal is 'into'. The Dee is a real Scottish river, though another of that name flows in Wales and England.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone drafted into the forces is a conscripted recruit.

clue.text: Some recent errors in the register

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A clerk notices a few fresh mistakes in the official records.
explanation.definitionFit: To record something in a register or ledger is to put it into the book.

clue.text: Bay is an unknown quantity

definitions.meaning: a bay is a reddish-brown, dark-coated horse
a competitor or candidate whose ability nobody can yet judge

explanation.surface: A bay window or bay leaf is called a mystery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bay' looks like a coastline or a tree; it is a horse colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark-coated horse is literally a bay, and figuratively the phrase means a surprise contender.

clue.text: Wants Irish leader lodged in fine house

indicators.note: lodged in says the leading letter is set inside the house's letters

parts.note: des res is estate-agent shorthand for a desirable residence

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of the word Irish

explanation.surface: An Irish chief is put up in a grand home and wants for nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'fine house' is British estate-agent slang for a desirable residence; 'lodged in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Wants as a plural noun are cravings or wishes.

clue.text: Terror causes many to study

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: Fear makes a great many people hit the books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'causes' is a link; D (500) is a crossword stand-in for many, and to read a subject is British for studying it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is intense fear, a synonym for terror.

clue.text: Helps curé renovate a mausoleum

indicators.note: to renovate is to rework, so the letters of the two words are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A parish priest gets help to restore a family tomb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'renovate' rearranges HELPS and CURE (the accent is dropped).
explanation.definitionFit: A sepulchre is a tomb or burial vault, as a mausoleum is.

clue.text: Blasted for having served spitted meat

definitions.meaning: meat turned on a spit over a fire has been cooked this way

explanation.surface: A cook is attacked for dishing up meat cooked on a skewer.
explanation.definitionFit: Criticised harshly and cooked over a fire are both senses of the word.

clue.text: Star venue for those wanting a tan

definitions.text: Star venue for those wanting a tan

parts.words: Star venue for those wanting a tan
parts.note: read as a dark spot on our star, or as a favourite holiday place for sunbathers

explanation.surface: A celebrity hangout where people go to get bronzed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star' suggests a celebrity; it is the sun, and a spot on it is a solar blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark patch on the solar surface shares its name with a resort for sunbathing.

clue.text: Rosetta ordered a kitchen item

indicators.note: ordered means arranged, so the letters of Rosetta are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Rosetta has bought a new appliance for the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' looks like purchasing; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A bread-browning appliance is a standard piece of kitchen equipment.

clue.text: To elucidate is no longer simple

parts.note: ex means former, no longer what one was
plain means simple or unadorned

explanation.surface: Making something clear is no longer straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: To elucidate is to make clear, which is what you do when you clarify a point.

clue.text: Critical moment to find a plumbing leak?

definitions.meaning: a turning point after which things change
... by a pipe, the question mark flagging the whimsical reading

explanation.surface: A plumber's crisis arrives when he finds the leak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to find' is a link; the second sense splits the answer as WATER SHED.
explanation.definitionFit: A decisive turning point is the figurative sense; water spilled from a pipe is the punning literal one.

clue.text: Rent out the attic and relax

parts.note: to let a property is to rent it out
the attic is up, at the top of the house

explanation.surface: Lease the loft to a lodger and take it easy.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease off or slacken is to relax one's efforts.

clue.text: Give in and return

definitions.meaning: a profit or crop produced, as on an investment

explanation.surface: Surrender and go back home.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to submit; the noun means the amount produced, as interest on capital.

clue.text: Made crazy car trip north to bring mother back

parts.note: a drive is a journey by car
N is the compass abbreviation for north

indicators.note: to bring back means the word for mother is read in reverse order

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse

explanation.surface: A long car journey north to collect mum drives someone round the bend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to bring mother back' reverses DAM, a crossword word for a mother animal, giving MAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Driven to distraction or insanity, someone has been made crazy.

clue.text: Eschewed comforts to produce rudimentary revision

definitions.meaning: lived without luxuries, as when camping
an early unpolished cut of a film or text

explanation.surface: Someone camped out to work on a first draft.
explanation.definitionFit: Living without home comforts and an early unrefined edit share the same words.

clue.text: An Italian paid up despite being footloose

parts.note: un is the Italian word for a or an
a debt settled has been paid up

explanation.surface: An Italian has cleared his debts yet still wanders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'despite being' is a link; 'An Italian' asks for the Italian word for 'an'.
explanation.definitionFit: Footloose means unattached and restless, not settled in one place.

clue.text: He praises reforms made by Jewish sect

indicators.note: reforms means reshapes, so the letters of the two words are reshaped

explanation.surface: A man praises reforms brought in by a religious group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reforms' looks like a noun; it is the verb signalling the rearrangement of HE PRAISES.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient strict-observance party of Judaism was known for its scholars of the law.

clue.text: Humourless Tuscan banker put on a veneer

parts.note: a banker is a river, having banks; the Po is an Italian river
faced means given a surface layer or facing

explanation.surface: A dour Italian banker put on a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banker' in crosswords is a river; the Po actually runs across northern Italy, near Tuscany.
explanation.definitionFit: Po-faced means stiffly solemn and disapproving.

clue.text: Such a post makes top-class marines feel ill

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the one read as I
RM stands for Royal Marines
to ail is to feel unwell

explanation.surface: Elite marines feel sick reading a letter from home.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 is written AI, the figure 1 standing as letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters sent by aeroplane are this kind of post.

clue.text: Antelope found in oriental country

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for east, the Orient
a land is a nation or country

explanation.surface: A deer-like beast was spotted in an eastern nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest African antelope is an ox-like species with spiralled horns.

clue.text: A cornet containing it is sheer poison

indicators.note: containing says the cornet's letters wrap round the word it

parts.note: an ice-cream cornet is a wafer cone
taken as written

explanation.surface: An ice cream with something inside is pure poison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cornet' looks like the brass instrument; it is an ice-cream cone. 'is sheer' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Monkshood or wolfsbane is a highly toxic plant, an old poison.

clue.text: Dusted as physician trimmed the border

parts.note: Dr is short for doctor, a physician
edged means gave a border or trimming

explanation.surface: A doctor neatened the edge of the flowerbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dusted' here means sprinkled, as a cook sprinkles flour or sugar.
explanation.definitionFit: A cook sprinkles flour or sugar over food, coating it lightly.

clue.text: Apply pressure on the church's behalf

parts.note: on behalf of someone is acting for them
CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: Lean on someone in the interests of the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on ... behalf' is split around 'the church's', so the two pieces sit in the clue in the reverse order of the answer; Church of England is the abbreviation needed.
explanation.definitionFit: To force is to compel or push hard.

clue.text: Sheriff's officer is to arrest east European

parts.note: to catch is to arrest or seize
a Pole is a native of Poland

explanation.surface: A lawman is to detain a man from Eastern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A bailiff or minor law officer who made arrests was historically called by this name.

clue.text: Firm embarrassed and disheartened

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
red-faced with embarrassment

explanation.surface: A company left blushing and downcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' means with its heart removed, as an apple is.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit with its central part removed has lost its heart.

clue.text: Hard-faced woman returned with colouring agent

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

indicators.note: returned means the woman's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A stern-faced woman came back with hair dye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faced' just places H at the front; 'returned' reverses ANNE to ENNA.
explanation.definitionFit: This reddish plant dye is used to colour hair and skin.

clue.text: Smoothie about to hurt east-end woman

parts.note: c is short for circa, about
to harm is to hurt
'er is her as dropped-h Cockney speech of London's East End

explanation.surface: A suave man is about to hurt a woman from London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: East Enders traditionally drop their h's, so 'her' becomes ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-talking charming person is informally a smoothie.

clue.text: You reach it going up the stairs or coming down

definitions.text: You reach it going up the stairs
definitions.meaning: the flat area at the top of a flight of steps
an aircraft's touchdown at the end of a flight

explanation.surface: A riddle about something met whether you climb or descend.
explanation.definitionFit: The platform between stair flights and an aircraft's arrival on the ground share the word.

clue.text: Under false impression that daughter escaped

parts.note: eluded means evaded or escaped

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly believed their daughter had got away.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone fooled or misled holds a mistaken belief.

clue.text: Late finish? There's no way out of it!

definitions.text: There's no way out of it!

parts.note: late means deceased, as in the late king
an end is a finish

explanation.surface: A death is the final finish with no escape.
explanation.definitionFit: A road closed at one end, a cul-de-sac, offers no exit.
